name: Mango Sticky Rice Ice Cream
desc: Inspired by the classic Thai dessert, this ice cream combines the tropical sweetness of mango with the creamy richness of coconut milk and sticky rice.
note: The coconut ice cream came out a bit icier than I'd hoped, so I would do 1 cup heavy cream and no whole milk next time to make it creamier.

sections.title: Coconut Ice Cream Base
steps: Shake up the can of coconut cream. Simmer the coconut cream, heavy cream, milk, sugar, and salt in a saucepan until the sugar is dissolved and the mixture is hot (but not boiling). I aim for around 150°F.
In a separate bowl, whisk the egg yolks. Slowly pour some of the hot cream mixture into the yolks while whisking to temper them.
Pour the tempered yolks back into the saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the custard thickens enough to coat the back of the spoon (about 170°F).
Remove from heat and strain through a fine-mesh sieve.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours.

sections.title: Mango Jam
steps: In a saucepan, combine the diced mangoes, sugar, and lemon juice and cook over medium heat until the mixture thickens and coats the back of a spoon (about 10-15 minutes).
Remove from heat and let cool completely before using.

sections.title: Mochi Bits
steps: Chop the mochi into small bite-sized pieces.

sections.title: Assembly
steps: Churn the coconut ice cream base in an ice cream maker until it reaches a soft-serve consistency.
Layer the ice cream, mango jam, and mochi bits in a container. Repeat until all components are used up.
Freeze the assembled ice cream overnight.
